_about: Alt text for the repo photos in photos/<room>/, in the same order as assets/js/photos.js. Used by tools/build_site.py (alt text is shown to screen readers and Google, not on the page). Describe only the room and its fixtures (loft, bed, desk, vanity, closet, bathroom), never tenants' belongings. Update this file whenever tools/prepare_photos.py changes a room's photos. A photo without alt text here gets 'Room N, photo i of n'.
